The central focus of the image is a large, transparent, diamond-shaped structure that appears to be floating above a tall, orange, geometric tower. The tower is composed of numerous rectangular blocks stacked together, creating a sense of depth and complexity. In the foreground, there is a solitary figure standing on the sandy ground, facing away from the viewer.
